title: Read the filter notebook environment report
description: You inspect environment fields and an optional NVIDIA diagnostic.

steps.description: You define _sh to capture shell output, including standard error. The helper prints captured text or a formatted exception.
You print Python, platform, and Colab information before the NVIDIA heading. The recording shows Python 3.12.16 on Linux with Colab False.

steps.question: What happens when the recorded shell cannot find nvidia-smi?
steps.answer: The helper prints the captured not-found diagnostic. The command's || true supplies a successful final shell status.
